en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a broad square or open park area in front of a tree‑lined boulevard. Several people ride bicycles and walk across the open space, with tram tracks and a tram visible in the middle distance. Behind the trees stands a large classical building with a greenish roof, likely a concert hall. A decorative iron fence runs along the foreground. The caption along the bottom margin reads in red Dutch text.
